engine.note: pivot is the effect's origin in frame px (pixelfx meta.origin): place it on the caster's hand, the target or the floor point the effect is drawn around

qa.method: fx_pixelfx v1: pixelfx tools/render.mjs --sheet --no-actor --bg none (the effect alone on transparency), sliced by its Aseprite JSON, optional binary alpha and nearest-colour snap (luminance-weighted RGB), re-packed
notProven: That the effect reads at the game's scale and against its backgrounds (look at preview.gif and in the game).
Timing against the character's action (pivot and hit frames are the effect's own; place it in the game).
That the license notice reaches the player-facing credits: CREDITS.txt must ship with the frames.

checks.note: frames with visible pixels on the canvas border (a cut glow shows as a box)
2 = binary alpha; more = soft glow edges (draw with alpha blending or use --alpha binary)
